name: Pricing & Packaging Review
summary: Reviews your pricing tiers against value metrics, unit costs and competitor price points.
description: Assesses whether your value metric, tier boundaries and price levels fit your ICP, computes gross margin per tier from the costs you supply, and proposes options with trade-offs.
problems: I don't know what to charge
I want to raise prices without losing customers

inputs.label: Current pricing
inputs.description: Your tiers, prices and what each includes.
inputs.example: Starter $49/mo (3 seats), Team $199/mo (15 seats), Enterprise custom

inputs.label: Unit costs
inputs.description: Cost to serve per customer or per unit.

outputs.label: Assessment
outputs.description: Strengths and problems of current pricing.

steps.name: Assess pricing
steps.responsibility: Evaluate value metric and tier structure.

steps.name: Compute margins
steps.responsibility: Calculate gross margin per tier from supplied costs.

dependencies.reason: Competitor price points anchor the options.
ICP budget and value drivers shape the value metric.

criteria.description: Each option states at least one downside.
Margins quoted in the options match the deterministic margin calculation.
